title: Relabeling an encoded graph
statement: Let $v$ be a natural number, let $sigma$ be a permutation of the vertex set ${0,1,ldots,v-1}$, and let $G$ be an encoded graph on that set. The relabeled graph assigns to each pair of vertices the edge status in $G$ of the pair obtained by applying $sigma^{-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $sigma$ is a permutation of the $v$-vertex set
$G$ is an encoded graph on that vertex set
